verdict.rationale: Agent identity is a fair question for an identity-bearing productivity platform like Google Workspace, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents human-user identity controls: SSO/SAML, Context-Aware Access, 2-Step Verification, user provisioning and the Cloud Identity API. Nothing treats AI agents as first-class identities or covers cross-app agent access, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials. These are adjacent controls and earn no credit.
